arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from icalendar import Calendar
with open('project_kickoff.ics', 'rb') as f:
    cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
print('Calendar version:', cal.get('version'))
for c in cal.walk():
    if c.name == 'VEVENT':
        print('Summary:', c.get('summary'))
        print('Start  :', c.get('dtstart').dt)
        print('End    :', c.get('dtend').dt)
        print('UID    :', c.get('uid'))
        print('Status :', c.get('status'))
print('ICS is valid')
PY
